The Arkansas Court of Appeals recently upheld a $3 million jury compensation award related to this case. Evidence submitted demonstrated that the remaining property value was adversely affected by the highway work.

But the decision proved costly as the hosts smashed 259/7 in 20 overs, their highest-ever total in T20Is. Chasing the mammoth target, India managed only 172/9 in their 20 overs.

Observations reveal that children often forget instructions as their attention shifts to other activities. Strategies such as providing visual reminders and making tasks more engaging can significantly help enhance their memory. Additionally, encouraging children to think ahead can promote greater responsibility in completing tasks.

With new cancellation policies being implemented by Indian Railways, travelers will face a new set of guidelines for managing ticket cancellations and refunds.

Commencing operations on October 31, this train will operate six days a week and provides three accommodation classes to cater to varying preferences.

description: A 62-year-old German educator faces fraud charges after reportedly taking a 16-year sick leave, during which she allegedly collected over €248,000 in salary. Investigators believe she fabricated medical documentation to support her prolonged absence from the classroom. Although she engaged in scuba diving, there’s no evidence of her undertaking any other professional work. The court is currently reviewing the case to determine if a full trial is warranted.

description: Researchers at the University of Sydney are investigating the medicinal properties of honey from stingless bees. The honey has shown effectiveness against various bacterial and fungal pathogens, including difficult-to-treat strains. Findings suggest that sugarbag honey is comparable in strength to well-known medical-grade honeys. While propolis displayed selective antimicrobial activity, the reason for honey's potency remains unclear. Further research is needed to identify the beneficial compounds within the honey.

description: Scientists studying 3,000-year-old objects from China's Sanxingdui archaeological site have found silk traces on 101 artefacts, including bronze masks, gold, jade and ivory objects. Published in the journal Antiquity, the study suggests that ancient Shu people used silk to wrap or cover objects during rituals. Researchers also identified red pigments and different weaving patterns, offering clues about ancient textile practices.

Emmons and Burleigh counties are challenging the state’s authority over pipeline routes, focusing on setback requirements. The Public Service Commission must now clarify its safety assessments and reconsider alternative routing options. Summit's broader carbon capture project faces multiple regulatory issues across several states, complicating its future.
title: North Dakota judge upholds local setbacks for pipeline, orders further review

description: Jeff Bezos shared insights on investing in artificial intelligence stocks while discussing broader market trends. He advised retirees to avoid individual AI stocks and consider S&P 500 investments instead. The ongoing surge in AI infrastructure investments highlights significant stock market developments. Bezos acknowledged the challenges of distinguishing between successful and unsuccessful AI ventures during economic booms.
title: Jeff Bezos shares Warren Buffett’s advice: Buy broader market, not AI stocks

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Mumbai Indians are undergoing a major overhaul, with Kieron Pollard taking charge as head coach and several key members exiting the support staff. Amid the uncertainty, bringing Rohit Sharma back as captain could offer stability, continuity and breathing space for the new coaching setup. With Tilak Varma viewed as a future leader, IPL 2027 could be about managing transition rather than chasing immediate glory.
title: Amidst winds of change, Rohit Sharma is the glue Mumbai Indians need right now

author: ANURAG BENDE AND VAIBHAV GANJAPURE
description: Abhijit Wanjarri's recent victory in the MLC elections against BJP's Sudhakar Kohale has raised concerns for the BJP's candidate selection process. The election resulted in over 15,000 invalid votes in Nagpur, indicating voter discontent and potential errors. BJP leader Chandrashekhar Bawankule acknowledged the defeat and pledged to improve strategies for future elections. Shiv Sena's involvement also contributed to disputes within the ruling coalition regarding support for various candidates.
title: MLC polls: Gadkari confidant's revolt may have hurt BJP in RSS bastion Nagpur

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned about the potential for urban violence during upcoming Halloween demonstrations. To manage this risk, around 70,000 police officers and gendarmes will be deployed across France. Demonstrations will be permitted, but not in city centres to prevent public disorder. Social media calls for gatherings have raised concerns about violence and unrest.
title: Halloween gatherings may trigger fresh violence: France to deploy 70k personnel

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: For countless individuals, rice serves as a comforting staple; however, its impact on blood glucose levels cannot be overlooked. A comprehensive review shows that various types of rice and their cooking methods can alter glycaemic responses. Interestingly, letting rice cool and then reheating it may promote resistant starch formation, which can help minimize glucose spikes. Choosing brown rice or millets over white rice can offer a healthier choice.
title: Low-GI rice varieties and cooking tips to cut blood sugar spikes

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Celine Dion was diagnosed with stiff person syndrome in 2022, a rare neurological disorder that affected her ability to walk and sing. As the singer prepared for her return to the stage in Paris, her foundation donated $2 million in 2024 towards research into the condition, highlighting her continued efforts to raise awareness and support scientific advancements.
title: Celine Dion donated $2M for stiff-person research before Paris comeback

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Crude oil prices are increasing as Brent crude surpasses $115 per barrel amid escalating tensions. Attacks by Yemen’s Houthi group on Saudi oil sites raise fears of supply disruptions. Efforts for diplomatic negotiations between Washington and Tehran remain unyielding, contributing to market uncertainty. Meanwhile, Iranian reports of maritime incidents further heighten security concerns in the Gulf region.
title: Oil prices cross $115 per barrel as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia stoke supply fears

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Qun Wan and Meiqin Xu have filed a lawsuit regarding their daughter's death attributed to ChatGPT's guidance. Their daughter, Bowen Wan, reduced her anti-seizure medication based on the chatbot's advice. This case raises concerns similar to Google CEO Sundar Pichai's warnings about AI's medical use. Previous lawsuits have addressed suicides linked to interactions with ChatGPT, indicating potential risks.
title: Woman dies after changing medication on ChatGPT advice; Google CEO had warned of risk

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: Kynan Chenai’s Asian Games mixed-team trap gold with Neeru Dhanda was built on grit, experience and a piece of sporting history -  a 38-year-old gun barrel inherited from his father, Darius. In this TOISA Spotlight, the Indian shooter reflects on his journey from his Olympic debut at Rio 2016 to the pursuit of a Los Angeles 2028 berth, the evolution of Indian shooting and his continuing search for perfection.
title: ‘I don’t think perfection exists’: Asiad medallist Kynan's unfinished Olympic pursuit

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: The Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in July to help children overcome financial barriers to sports. The program provides 120 players aged 8 to 10 with uniforms, Nike cleats and equipment at no cost. Supported by community partners, the initiative also offers coach stipends and referee training for teenagers. The league aims to expand access, support local families and encourage greater participation, particularly among girls.
title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current opens free soccer league for 120 children

author: HADI KHAN
description: Overnight rain affected various areas in Delhi-NCR, leading to a drop in temperatures and improved air quality. The city's Air Quality Index fell to the 'moderate' category after being 'poor' for two days. Visuals captured from places like Hazrat Nizamuddin railway station showed rain-soaked roads. Steady showers were reported in the Jamia Millia Islamia area late on Thursday. Dark clouds covered the city, indicating significant rainfall.
title: Delhi-NCR feels winter chill after overnight rain, AQI improves to 'moderate'

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: In a dazzling comeback, Azmatullah Omarzai rescued Afghanistan with an extraordinary century, scoring 116 runs from 50 deliveries after a shaky start against Zimbabwe. This achievement marked a record for T20I lower-order batters. His pivotal collaboration with Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai, worth 142 runs for the sixth wicket, pushed Afghanistan to a total of 221/7. Although Zimbabwe's Sikandar Raza matched him with a century, the chase ultimately proved futile.
title: Azmatullah Omarzai scripts history after walking in at 5/4, smashes T20I world record

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: In 2010, Taylor Swift made a significant contribution of $100,000 to help rebuild the Kids Kingdom playground in Hendersonville after it was severely damaged by flooding. Originally built in 1996, the playground had encountered numerous safety challenges. Currently, officials are looking into a $3 million grant aimed at enhancing recreational facilities, particularly focusing on developing an all-inclusive playground for children of varying abilities.
title: Taylor Swift donated $100,000 to rebuild flood-hit Tennessee playground in 2010

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Rashid Khan achieved a historic milestone by taking his 200th T20I wicket during a match against Zimbabwe. The moment occurred in Sharjah as he dismissed Tadiwanashe Marumani for only two runs. Azmatullah Omarzai played a crucial role, scoring 116 runs and helping Afghanistan recover from a challenging start. Afghanistan posted an impressive total of 221 runs, securing an eighth straight series victory over Zimbabwe.

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Inspired by WWE star Roman Reigns and nicknamed ‘Khatima ka Russell’ for his big-hitting prowess, Indian Army havaldar Kapil Pokhariya took an unconventional route to boxing. Growing up in a small Uttarakhand village, he went from punching homemade bags filled with mountain soil to winning bronze in the men’s 90kg category at the 2026 Asian Games. Kapil reflects on his childhood, his father’s support, his Army journey and his dream of Olympic glory.
title: Roman Reigns inspired his punches, Russell gave him a nickname: Meet Kapil Pokhariya

author: TNN
description: In a significant development, the Rajasthan government has placed senior IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal under an awaiting posting order amidst serious allegations. These claims suggest that Agrawal and his family acquired multiple properties from the same firm within a two-and-a-half-year span. Previously, he held vital roles, including additional chief secretary of industries.
title: 40 villas in 2.5 years? Why Rajasthan IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal was put on APO

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Researchers investigating Turkey’s ship-shaped Durupınar Formation claim to have found charred and uncharred wood nearly 30 feet underground. The team believes the findings could offer clues about the biblical Noah’s Ark, but the discovery remains unverified. Earlier radar scans and soil analysis have also fuelled their claims, though independent scientific evidence is needed to establish the site’s origins.
title: Noah’s Ark mystery: Researchers find wood 30 feet underground in Turkey

author: TNN
description: Karwa Chauth is being celebrated by women from different faiths in Lucknow. These celebrations involve prayers for the health and happiness of their husbands. Participants express their commitment to marriage through rituals, such as fasting throughout the day. Couples join in the festivities, often exchanging meaningful gestures that represent their love. This practice illustrates how cultural traditions are embraced across various communities, transcending religious divides.
title: From Catholic to Muslim, women across faiths celebrated Karwa Chauth in Lucknow

author: VAIBHAV GANJAPURE AND ABHISHEK CHOUDHARI
description: Abhijit Wanjarri's re-election win for Congress in Nagpur's graduates' constituency became a highlight as it represented the party’s single success among four states. This victory came as the BJP-led NDA claimed 16 out of a total of 28 seats. Independent candidate Nitesh Karale played a pivotal role in shaping the electoral outcome.
title: How lone crusader put Congress on victory lap

author: VISHAL PATADIYA
description: A court in Virginia ruled in favor of Parimal Desai and Kanu Gandhi's charitable trust regarding land ownership. Gregory Black claimed ownership of the land under the adverse possession rule after 15 years. Following a legal battle, the court found that Black could not prove his exclusive possession. The court directed Black to remove his belongings and surrender possession of the land.
title: Gandhi grandson's 30-acre US land reclaimed after 20-month legal battle
